adjudication.rationale: The handler gates all logic on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:14-17). That constant is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts), so if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset or empty, the endpoint returns 403 before the header/secret comparison. Therefore the described `undefined !== undefined` bypass cannot occur as claimed from this diff.
